description: This file defines the LimitRateByRejection class, a stream processor for limiting element throughput in Akka streams, forwarding or rejecting elements based on their position within a time window.

classes.name: LimitRateByRejection
classes.description: A final class providing static methods to create a rate-limiting stream graph based on rejection logic.

classes.name: Logic
classes.description: A private static inner class implementing the logic for counting elements within a time window and generating either accepted elements or errors.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a graph that limits the number of elements passing through in a specified time window, rejecting excess elements and generating errors via the errorReporter function.

methods.name: creator
methods.description: A static method that creates a Creator for Logic instances, parameterized by the time window, max elements, and error reporter.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies the logic to an element, determining if it should be forwarded or rejected based on the current count within the time window.
